description: dgen, published by NatLabRockies, provides the Distributed Generation Market Demand model with documented container, database and cloud setup routes. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. The licence is BSD-3-Clause. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: The installation documentation requires substantial database storage and a legacy Python environment; precise model assumptions were not audited. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
